question: Who wrote the autobiography entitled ‘I am No Messiah’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonu Sood.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonu Sood's** autobiography** 'I am no Messiah' is out now;** Rajkumar and Aparshakti congratulate the actor.
 
• Sonu Sood, who has worked towards helping the needy during the ongoing Covid-19 pandemic has inspired and won the hearts of many.
 
• **The book will be co-authored by Meena Iyer.**

 [IMAGE: https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71o7FRX6P0L.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sachin Ramesh Tendulkar **is an Indian former international cricketer who captained the Indian national team.

 
 
• He is regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
 
 
• **Paramahansa Yogananda** was an Indian** Hindu monk, yogi and guru** who introduced millions to the teachings of meditation and Kriya Yoga through his organization.
 
• **Avul Pakir Jainulabdeen Abdul Kalam **was an Indian aerospace scientist and statesman who served as the **11th President of India from 2002 to 2007. **
 
 
• He was born and raised in Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu and studied physics and aerospace engineering.
